sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 60 Cost.
Cost recovery boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies iron wall for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Heals CP by 10% of max CP every 5 seconds for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Heals 40% of max HP every 5 seconds for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Dark Qualia (increases all stats by 100%, increases dark elemental attack by 10, increases dark elemental defense by 150, and nullifies Rejection and Psychological Contamination) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000
Confuse and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 70

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 150 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
